notes: All numerical thresholds are predeclared before any facility delivers data. Thresholds marked PROPOSED may be adjusted by the owner without code changes by editing this file.

gate_1_old_pigment_labeling.name: Gate 1 — Old-pigment pre-labeling
gate_1_old_pigment_labeling.fallback: Replace old/new separation with melanosome counting via electron-microscopy pulse-chase. The old-pool term is then recorded as unidentified in the washout model.

c1_baseline_separation.description: Quantifiable separation of heavy- and light-melanin fractions at baseline

c2_old_pool_fraction_lod.description: Old-pool fraction detectable above LOD after a 7-day chase; detection limit ≤ 10 % of total melanin signal

c3_chemical_melanin_agreement.description: Agreement with total chemical melanin within stated tolerance on a validation subset

gate_2_free_compound_validation.name: Gate 2 — Intracellular free-compound assay validation (per compound)
gate_2_free_compound_validation.fallback: A compound that fails its validation is excluded from free-compound-corrected washout fitting for that arm.

c4_freeze_thaw_stability.description: Stability through at least one freeze-thaw cycle

gate_3_ampyrone_solubility.name: Gate 3 — Ampyrone solubility window
gate_3_ampyrone_solubility.fallback: Run at highest soluble concentration with limitation declared; defer 21-day mature-pigment arm until formulation route found.

c2_concentration_drop.description: Drop in nominal concentration at 6 days by LC-MS/MS

c3_cell_viability.description: Cell viability at highest soluble concentration relative to vehicle
